recipe.name: Chicken Biryani
recipe.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with marinated chicken, aromatic spices, herbs, and onions.

steps.step: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 20 minutes.
Marinate chicken with yogurt and biryani masala.
Fry sliced onions until golden brown.
Cook the marinated chicken until almost done.
Cook the rice separately until seventy percent cooked.
Layer rice and chicken and cook on low heat until fully done.

recipe.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipe.description: Soft paneer cubes cooked in a creamy tomato and butter gravy.

steps.step: Cook onions and tomatoes until soft.
Blend the cooked mixture into a smooth puree.
Heat butter and add the tomato puree.
Add spices and simmer the gravy.
Add paneer cubes and fresh cream.
Cook for five more minutes and serve.

recipe.name: Vegetable Pulao
recipe.description: Lightly spiced rice cooked with mixed vegetables and aromatic whole spices.

steps.step: Wash and soak rice for fifteen minutes.
Cover and cook until rice is tender.

recipe.name: Palak Paneer
recipe.description: Paneer cooked in a smooth spinach gravy with Indian spices.

steps.step: Blanch spinach and blend into a puree.

recipe.name: Chana Masala
recipe.description: Chickpeas cooked in a spicy tomato and onion gravy.

recipe.name: Chicken Tikka
recipe.description: Boneless chicken marinated with yogurt and spices and grilled until smoky.

steps.step: Combine yogurt, spices, and lemon juice.
Marinate chicken for at least one hour.
Grill until cooked and lightly charred.

recipe.name: Masala Dosa
recipe.description: Crispy fermented rice and lentil crepe filled with spiced potato masala.

steps.step: Prepare potato masala with onion and spices.
Spread dosa batter thinly on a hot pan.

recipe.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipe.description: Stir-fried rice prepared with eggs, vegetables, soy sauce, and spring onions.

steps.step: Scramble eggs in a hot wok.
Add soy sauce and spring onions.

recipe.name: Vegetable Noodles
recipe.description: Chinese-style noodles stir-fried with colorful vegetables and sauces.

steps.step: Stir fry vegetables over high heat.

recipe.name: Chilli Chicken
recipe.description: Indo-Chinese chicken tossed with peppers, onions, chilli sauce, and soy sauce.

recipe.name: Margherita Pizza
recipe.description: Classic Italian pizza topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and basil.

steps.step: Spread tomato sauce over the base.
Bake until the crust is golden.

recipe.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipe.description: Simple Italian pasta tossed with garlic, olive oil, chilli flakes, and parsley.

steps.step: Toss cooked pasta in the garlic oil.

recipe.name: Penne Arrabbiata
recipe.description: Penne pasta served in a spicy tomato, garlic, and chilli sauce.

steps.step: Add tomatoes and cook into a sauce.

recipe.name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
recipe.description: Creamy pasta prepared with chicken, parmesan cheese, butter, and cream.

steps.step: Cook sliced chicken in a pan.
Add parmesan and stir until smooth.
Add pasta and chicken to the sauce.

recipe.name: Vegetable Lasagna
recipe.description: Layered pasta baked with vegetables, tomato sauce, white sauce, and cheese.

steps.step: Layer lasagna sheets, vegetables, and tomato sauce.

recipe.name: Chicken Tacos
recipe.description: Mexican tortillas filled with seasoned chicken, vegetables, and salsa.

steps.step: Fill tortillas with chicken and vegetables.

recipe.name: Vegetable Burrito
recipe.description: Large tortilla filled with rice, beans, vegetables, salsa, and guacamole.

steps.step: Add rice, beans, vegetables, and guacamole.

recipe.name: Cheese Quesadilla
recipe.description: Mexican tortilla grilled with melted cheese and vegetables.

steps.step: Place cheese and vegetables over one tortilla.
Cook on both sides until golden.

recipe.name: Mexican Bean Salad
recipe.description: Fresh salad made with beans, corn, tomato, onion, avocado, and lime.

steps.step: Combine beans, corn, and chopped vegetables.

recipe.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
recipe.description: Fresh mixed salad topped with seasoned grilled chicken and lemon dressing.

recipe.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
recipe.description: Rich continental soup prepared with mushrooms, cream, garlic, and herbs.

steps.step: Saute mushrooms and garlic in butter.

recipe.name: French Toast
recipe.description: Bread slices dipped in seasoned egg and milk mixture and pan toasted.

steps.step: Dip bread slices into the mixture.
Cook on a pan until golden on both sides.

recipe.name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
recipe.description: Healthy bowl with quinoa, chickpeas, vegetables, avocado, and tahini dressing.

steps.step: Arrange quinoa, chickpeas, avocado, and vegetables in a bowl.

recipe.name: Garlic Bread
recipe.description: Toasted bread spread with garlic butter and herbs.

recipe.name: Chinese Vegetable Soup
recipe.description: Light vegetable soup flavored with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and pepper.

recipe.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipe.description: Spicy Chinese chicken stir fry prepared with peanuts, vegetables, and savory sauce.

recipe.name: Paneer Tikka
recipe.description: Paneer cubes marinated with yogurt and Indian spices and grilled with vegetables.

recipe.name: Tomato Basil Pasta
recipe.description: Pasta tossed with fresh tomato sauce, basil, garlic, and olive oil.

steps.step: Add tomatoes and cook into a sauce.

recipe.name: Avocado Toast
recipe.description: Toasted bread topped with seasoned mashed avocado and tomato.

steps.step: Mash avocado with lemon juice and seasoning.

steps.step: Cover and cook until rice is tender.
